releaseNotes:
Official Release v1.3.129:
- INDIVIDUAL STAFF IDENTIFICATION: Recognizes and greets enrolled staff by their personal name on splash biometric login, setting active cashier globally.
- MANAGER OVERRIDE AUTHENTICATION: Corrected modalAuth verification so touching DigitalPersona 4500 immediately authorizes Manager and Admin functions cleanly.
- STAFF TABLE FINGERPRINT BADGE: Clear FP: YES (green) and FP: NO (neutral) badges in Staff Management table indicating enrolled fingerprint credentials.
- IDLE DISPLAY AUTO-LOCK: Reorganized Hardware & Devices with top-level Idle Display tab, Check enable toggle, and 30s, 1m, 2m, and Never lock duration options.
- REORGANIZED HARDWARE SETUP: Clean, uncluttered layout grouping subtabs logically across the entire management pane.
- DRIVER PACKAGE EMBEDDED: DigitalPersona Legacy Driver v4.1.0.217 installer bundled in Hardware_Drivers for fast offline installation.
- 100% Quality Standard: 0 errors and 0 warnings across all integrity vectors.
